verdict.rationale: Atlassian's first-party pages say Jira supports custom automation rules, from automated reminders to rules that move work forward and auto-assignment, and that automation connects tools like Bitbucket and Slack to any Jira workflow to keep it up to date without manual effort. The evidence is marketing-level only, so the trigger-and-action structure is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the trigger/condition/action rule builder, detail on available triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building rules.
